# Reference faces

`eyes-open.jpg` and `eyes-closed.jpg` are 256×256 crops of NASA's portrait of astronaut Eileen
Collins, a work of the US government in the public domain (NASA Great Images,
https://flic.kr/p/r9qvLn), as shipped in scikit-image 0.26 as `skimage/data/astronaut.png`.

- `eyes-open.jpg`: the crop, unchanged. She smiles.
- `eyes-closed.jpg`: the same crop with both eyes painted over with eyelid skin tone and a lash
  line, so Apple Vision's eye landmarks close.
- `looking-aside.jpg`: the same crop with both irises moved 6 pixels to the side, the place they
  left filled with the eye white beside them, so she looks aside with her head unchanged.

`neutral.jpg` is a 256×256 crop, saved as RGB, of Alexander Gardner's portrait of
Abraham Lincoln of November 8, 1863, in the public domain
(https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Abraham_Lincoln_O-77_matte_collodion_print.jpg). His
expression is neutral.

`turned-away.jpg` is an 800×800 crop, scaled to 256×256, of the Bain News Service's portrait of
Dr. Herbert John Webber, circa 1910 to 1915, in the public domain (Library of Congress,
ggbain.12548,
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Herbert_John_Webber_side_profile.jpg). His head is
turned about three-quarters away from the camera.
